en.name: Kun Zhang
en.tagline: I study how language models are measured — and I ship the code and data so the measurement can be checked.
en.intro: MSc Advanced Computer Science at the University of Leeds. First-author paper at NLPCC 2026 (oral) on why the standard multiple-choice scorer breaks on Chinese benchmarks, with the full artifact released under a DOI. Two threads: evaluation methodology and model reliability; language models on financial text.

zh.kicker: 硕士 · 自然语言处理与大语言模型 · 评测与可靠性
zh.name: 张鲲
zh.tagline: 我研究语言模型该如何被度量——并把代码与数据一并公开，让度量本身可被检验。
zh.intro: 利兹大学高级计算机科学硕士。第一作者论文发表于 NLPCC 2026（口头报告），揭示主流 MCQ 打分法在中文基准上失效的机制，完整工件已挂 DOI 公开。两条主线：评测方法与模型可靠性；面向金融文本的大语言模型。
